profile.summary: FluxRail's origination assumptions center on connector reliability, template efficiency, cash conversion, and leverage headroom, with inferred assumptions on stable working capital and connector support continuity.

assumptions.title: Renewals depend on reliable workflow execution across the largest supported identity and ERP connectors.
assumptions.claim: Renewals depend on reliable workflow execution across the largest supported identity and ERP connectors.

evidence.quote: Renewals depend on reliable workflow execution across the largest supported identity and ERP connectors.

assumptions.title: Reusable configuration templates keep implementation labor contained and shorten customer deployment cycles.
assumptions.claim: Reusable configuration templates keep implementation labor contained and shorten customer deployment cycles.

evidence.quote: Reusable configuration templates keep implementation labor contained and shorten customer deployment cycles.

assumptions.title: Subscription billing and 42-day receivable collection support positive annual operating cash generation after required investment.
assumptions.claim: Subscription billing and 42-day receivable collection support positive annual operating cash generation after required investment.

evidence.quote: Subscription billing and 42-day receivable collection support positive annual operating cash generation after required investment.

assumptions.title: Opening leverage leaves adequate earnings headroom while transaction restrictions preserve cash and collateral value.
assumptions.claim: Opening leverage leaves adequate earnings headroom while transaction restrictions preserve cash and collateral value.

evidence.quote: Opening leverage leaves adequate earnings headroom while transaction restrictions preserve cash and collateral value.

assumptions.title: Stable 42-day receivable collection supports consistent working capital absorption.
assumptions.claim: Stable 42-day receivable collection supports consistent working capital absorption.

assumptions.title: Connector support continuity prevents workflow outages affecting ≥10% of revenue.
assumptions.claim: Connector support continuity prevents workflow outages affecting ≥10% of revenue.

evidence.quote: The principal vulnerability is integration reliability: failed identity or ERP connectors could increase support cost and weaken renewals before leverage shows the full effect.

relationships.rationale: Reliable connector execution prevents outages that trigger renewal risk and customer notices.
Template efficiency reduces deployment friction, supporting reliable connector-dependent workflows.
Subscription billing and 42-day collections drive cash conversion, stabilizing working capital absorption.
Adequate earnings headroom supports cash generation capacity needed for debt service and investment.
